contract_axes.contract_axis_name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
contract_axes.basis: All brief obligations and negative constraints reviewed. Revision-specific progress, retired/versioned search, local data, accessibility, handouts, review and phases are retained. Required paste-input research remains omitted (CC-C01).

contract_axes.contract_axis_name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
contract_axes.basis: Governing source facts and conditions checked with primary docs, pinned code/callers/tests and issue/release context. DOCX-file evidence does not establish clipboard behavior (CC-C01). Other assessed source facts remain supported, with recorded minor limits.

contract_axes.contract_axis_name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
contract_axes.basis: Useful authoring/storage and offline/export alternatives, browser/native data, optional backups and consequential history assessed. No winning product inferred. Available paste/normalization mechanism research is missing (CC-C01); owner preferences do not excuse it.

contract_axes.contract_axis_name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
contract_axes.basis: Every exact plan clause and control critic finding/disposition reviewed. The carry-forward and renderer guarantees are correctly rejected; S18 correction is sound and nonexistent C17 remains disclosed.

contract_axes.contract_axis_name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
contract_axes.basis: Complete final meaning checked against discovery, full draft, criticism and source maps. Supported data policies, alternatives, optional local backups, owner questions and validation limits remain. No additional supported-meaning loss found.

contract_axes.contract_axis_name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
contract_axes.basis: Validation proposals have meaningful synthetic offline/search/update/revision/import/accessibility/print/privacy acceptance criteria. Repository tests were inspected, not run; no product validation or deployment is required or falsely claimed. Paste-specific research is the identified source omission, not a retrospective demand for executing tests.

obligations.obligation: Pages, diagrams, exercises and maintainable authoring/storage alternatives
obligations.basis: Structured content, version identity, review and alternative costs examined; no product winner.
Cached/app versus local-file/index constraints are distinguished; no automatic offline-readiness claim.

obligations.obligation: Local personal progress, no learner account/upload
obligations.basis: Origin/device scope, optional local backup, no sync/network progress and storage loss limits retained.

obligations.obligation: Preserve progress through updates; material changed exercise cannot inherit completion
obligations.final_locator: Revision policy; plan dispositions; interrupted-update tests
obligations.basis: Exact exercise revision history and explicit reviewed nonmaterial equivalence are proposals consistent with brief; atomic update/migration is a test target.

obligations.obligation: Search versions and retired lessons; inspectable history
obligations.basis: Clear status/version/replacement metadata, current-first/filter and owner retention choices retained; generator defaults do not supply policy.

obligations.obligation: Keyboard, meaningful sequence, diagrams and no text-image substitution
obligations.basis: Normative versus informative authority distinguished; equivalent instructions and text remain; no conformance certification.
DOCX limits are valid but literal paste representation/normalization remains unresearched; decisive required omission CC-C01.

obligations.obligation: Export fidelity; printable handouts for non-installers; no print/app parity
obligations.basis: Separate HTML/PDF/EPUB or print behavior and output/diagram/table/order checks retained. No arbitrary fidelity or interactive paper progress claim.

obligations.obligation: Modest author review and phased adoption
obligations.basis: Preview, reviewed revision/materiality, signoff and synthetic-first adoption are meaningful proposed workflows.

obligations.obligation: No publication, volunteer installation or real learner-record processing; distinguish proposed/executed
obligations.basis: No product deployment or learner-data processing claimed; source reading and test inspection are distinct from execution.

obligations.obligation: Exact plan dispositions, all criticism and draft-to-final supported meaning
obligations.basis: All clauses and critic dispositions checked; no supported meaning was silently discarded.

source_families.family: Authoring/storage, search, offline distribution and optional mechanisms
source_families.finite_scope: Consequential claims and comparisons, including local-file/hosted differences; not every CMS/plugin in existence.
Reader, caller/options, focused tests/history and available paste schema mechanisms. Missing candidate research identified, no actual paste result invented.
Documented format/engine distinctions and normative exceptions; no rendered output or full conformance audit required.

source_families.family: Local data, storage, persistence and update lifecycle
source_families.finite_scope: Origin/permission/transaction/worker and filesystem conditions; actual network/privacy/durability behavior remains proposed.
Report versus reproduction/fix, source scope, applicable version and dated maintenance evidence; no primary source opinion promoted to unrelated upstream governance.
Documented editor/export/review mechanisms; mandatory release governance is a proposed group policy.

scientific_document_coverage: COMPLETE: identical hashed brief/plan; both full discovery/draft/critique/final/source maps/indexes and all dispositions. Control unchanged final blocks verified against the completely read draft, with every final delta read.
outside_finite_proposal_scope: Actual authored sample fidelity and output/UI conformance
Selected host/browser/type installed behavior and owner preferences
Product deployment or processing learning records
limits: COMPLETE describes finite source review, not observed runtime implementation or exhaustive universal research.
